title: Waterway Impact

A single infrastructure project changed the course of history for the Indian subcontinent. The Indus Basin Irrigation System, a $35 billion waterway, has had a profound impact on the region by providing a stable source of water for irrigation, leading to the growth of cities and industries. This project has reshaped the fabric of the area, supporting massive civilizations and demonstrating the power of regional cooperation.
